t: LAP Coldstrip outdoor Blue LED Recessed Deck Light Kit features a robust metal and acrylic construction with a stylish brushed chrome finish, designed for seamless integration into outdoor spaces. These round LED lights emit a captivating blue light, perfect for illuminating garden paths, decking areas, and patios, creating an inviting ambience. Each light fits a 25mm cut-out and includes adjustable legs to ensure a secure installation. Rated IP67, the units offer excellent protection against dust and water ingress, ensuring reliable performance in various outdoor conditions. Supplied complete with an LED driver and fixings, installation is straightforward for garden and landscape projects.
